about: Night bans on renting shared scooters. A night belongs to the evening it starts on: "fri" with 00:00–05:00 is the early hours of Saturday. Bans on the eve of public holidays are left out.
areaSource: Norwegian municipalities from Kartverket (CC BY 4.0), British local authority districts from the ONS (Open Government Licence v3.0) and Portuguese municipalities from the CAOP (Informação geográfica cedida pela Direção-Geral do Território, CC BY 4.0), simplified to within 100 m by scripts/update-curfew-areas.mjs

curfews.note: The rule bans every night but lets the city trial weekday nights, and Voi and Ryde open them. Only Friday and Saturday nights are sure.
The rule (FOR-2025-02-27-363 § 6 c) says 00:00–05:00, the city page 23:00–06:00 and Voi, the only operator, 23:00–05:00. The hours two of the three agree on are kept.
